# Stop 19,795 raw ticket/PR routes and 2,253-item SSR sidebars from diluting Google Search Console indexing

## Context

In Google Search Console (`Last 3 months`, inspected with `@tobiu` on `2026-10-24`), `https://neomjs.com` ranks almost exclusively for Air India flight numbers (`ai12742` — `4,137` impressions / `0` clicks; `ai10794` — `699` impressions / `0` clicks), CI error strings (`"git_no_lazy_fetch" "2.43"` — `578` impressions / `0` clicks), and bare `"neo"`, with **zero** rankings for relevant engineering keywords (`agent os`, `multi-threaded web framework`, `offscreencanvas worker`, `mcp memory core`, etc.).

**Sweep Attestations (`ticket-create §1a`):**
- `Live latest-open sweep:` checked latest 20 open issues in `neomjs/neo` (`#19145`–`#20086`) and `neomjs/middleware-v2` (`#9`–`#34`) at `2026-10-24T01:07:10Z`; no equivalent open ticket found.
- `A2A in-flight claim sweep:` checked latest 30 messages (`status: 'all'`); no competing claim on sitemap ticket dilution or SSR ticket sidebar bloat.
- `MC sweep:` `query_raw_memories({query: "middleware-v2 Googlebot Search Console sitemap SsrService canonical SEO"})`, 10 results; no prior decision addressing the `98.5%` ticket/PR sitemap skew or `2,253`-item SSR sidebar DOM bloat.
- `Own-assignment sweep:` 0 open issues assigned to `@neo-gemini-julia` in `neomjs/neo` or `neomjs/middleware-v2`.

## The Problem

Live empirical inspection of `https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml` and `https://neomjs.com/news/tickets/12742` (as `User-Agent: Googlebot`) revealed two compounding structural causes:

1. **Extreme Sitemap & `llms.txt` Dilution (`98.5%` raw issue/PR churn vs `0.6%` documentation):**
   - Out of `20,266` total URLs in `https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml` (and `20,900` lines in `apps/portal/llms.txt`):
     - `12,553` (`61.9%`) are `/news/tickets/*`
     - `6,895` (`34.0%`) are `/news/pulls/*`
     - `347` (`1.7%`) are `/news/discussions/*`
     - `151` (`0.7%`) are `/news/releases/*`
     - Only **`124` (`0.61%`)** are `/learn/*` guides, **`20` (`0.10%`)** are `/news/blog/*` posts, **`94` (`0.46%`)** are `/examples/*`, and **`81` (`0.40%`)** are `/apps/*`.
   - Submitting `19,795` raw GitHub issue/PR/discussion URLs in the single flat `sitemap.xml` (and `llms.txt`) swamps crawl budget and context windows, telling Google and LLM crawlers that `neomjs.com` is an issue-tracker mirror rather than an engineering documentation and product site.

2. **`~360 KB` / `2,253`-item Sidebar `TreeList` Boilerplate & Raw Frontmatter in Every Ticket SSR Page:**
   - Fetching `https://neomjs.com/news/tickets/12742` as `Googlebot` returns **`359,525` bytes** (`~360 KB`) of HTML, of which over `90%` is `2,253` `<li class="neo-list-item">` nodes inside the left-hand `neo-treelist-1` sidebar (`~4.5 GB` of identical ticket-title boilerplate repeated across `12,553` ticket pages when `idMap.json` is not served).
   - Furthermore, `Portal.view.news.tickets.Component#frontMatterToHtml` (`apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs:67-103`) renders raw markdown frontmatter (`id: 12742`, `title`, `state`, `labels: ai`) as table rows at the very top of `<article>` even though `title`, `state`, and `labels` are already rendered in the `<h1>` heading and `<div class="neo-ticket-labels">` badge bar right below it — tokenizing `id 12742 ... labels ai` into `ai12742` and `ai10794` and causing Google Search Console to match thousands of searches for **Air India flight AI 12742 and AI 10794** (`4,836` combined impressions, `0` clicks)!

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority: "The SEO Generator script produces two distinct artifacts with different scopes: 1. llms.txt (Curated Context)... 2. sitemap.xml (Exhaustive Index): Contains all routes from llms.txt PLUS all ticket routes. This ensures search engines can index our entire knowledge base, including resolved issues, while keeping the LLM context file lean." (buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs)`
- That original design assumption scaled poorly once the repository grew from a few hundred tickets to **`19,795` tickets/PRs/discussions** (`98.5%` of `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt`).
- Meanwhile, `Portal.view.news.pulls.Component#frontMatterToHtml` (`apps/portal/view/news/pulls/Component.mjs:81`) already skips `number` via a `skip` map, whereas `Portal.view.news.tickets.Component#frontMatterToHtml` (`apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs:67-103`) still renders duplicate `id`, `title`, `state`, and `labels` rows inside `<table class="neo-frontmatter-table">`.

## The Fix

1. **In `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` (`neomjs/neo`):**
   - Exclude raw `tickets`, `pull-requests`, and `discussions` archive categories from `getSitemapXml()` and `getLlmsTxt()` by default (`includeArchives = false`), keeping `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` focused on `/`, `/learn/*`, `/news/blog/*`, `/news/releases/*`, `/examples/*`, `/apps/*`, and `/docs` (`~476` high-value canonical pages) while supporting `includeArchives: true` / `--include-archives` when an exhaustive archive dump is explicitly requested.
   - Skip scanning `collectIssueRoutes`, `collectPullRoutes`, and `collectDiscussionRoutes` inside `collectAllRoutes` when `includeArchives: false` so `getSitemapXml` and `getLlmsTxt` also avoid scanning `19,795` corpus files unnecessarily, while `getContentRoutes` and `getContentRouteObjects` continue to default to `includeArchives = true` for SPA route-table consumers.
2. **In `apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs` (`Portal.view.news.tickets.Component#frontMatterToHtml`):**
   - Omit `id`, `title`, `state`, and `labels` rows from `frontMatterToHtml(data)` (matching `Portal.view.news.pulls.Component#frontMatterToHtml`'s `skip` pattern), since those four fields are already rendered in the ticket `<h1>` title and `.neo-ticket-labels` badge bar, eliminating duplicate metadata rows and raw `id: <number>` + `labels: ai` token combinations at the top of ticket pages.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `getSitemapXml` & `getLlmsTxt` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`) | `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs:758-1230` (amends scope) | Excludes raw `/news/tickets/*`, `/news/pulls/*`, and `/news/discussions/*` churn from primary `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` by default (`includeArchives = false`) | `includeArchives: true` option / `--include-archives` CLI flag | Module & function JSDoc in `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` |
| `Portal.view.news.tickets.Component#frontMatterToHtml` (`apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs`) | `apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs:67-103` & `apps/portal/view/news/pulls/Component.mjs:77-112` | Skips `id`, `title`, `state`, and `labels` rows in `.neo-frontmatter-table` (already rendered in H1 + `.neo-ticket-labels` header badges) and returns `''` when no non-header rows remain | Other frontmatter keys (`author`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `closedAt`, `subIssues`, etc.) continue to render in `.neo-frontmatter-table` | Method JSDoc in `apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs` | `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.spec.mjs` |

## Decision Record impact

`none` (amends JSDoc design assumption in `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Primary `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` generated by `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` include `/`, `/learn/*`, `/news/blog/*`, `/news/releases/*`, `/examples/*`, and `/apps/*` without flooding `98.5%` of entries with `/news/tickets/*`, `/news/pulls/*`, and `/news/discussions/*` (while `includeArchives: true` / `--include-archives` retains them when requested, and `getContentRoutes()` continues to return all SPA routes).
- [ ] `Portal.view.news.tickets.Component#frontMatterToHtml` (`apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs`) omits duplicate `id`, `title`, `state`, and `labels` rows from `.neo-frontmatter-table` so raw `id: <number>` and `labels: ai` frontmatter table tokens are not emitted ahead of the H1 title.
- [ ] JSDoc in `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` and `apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs` is updated to reflect why raw ticket/PR/discussion churn and duplicate frontmatter rows are excluded from primary search and LLM indexing.

## Out of Scope

- Per-route `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, and `<link rel="canonical">` injection in `SsrService.mjs` (tracked in sibling `neomjs/middleware-v2#35` & `#36`).
- Doubled `/news/blog/blog/<slug>` route bug (resolved in `neomjs/neo#20088` / PR `#20096`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Keeping 19,795 raw tickets/PRs indexed in primary `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt`:** Even with proper `<title>` tags, `19,795` auto-generated issue/PR pages outnumber our `124` `/learn/*` guides by `160:1`, guaranteeing crawl-budget and topical-authority dilution on a domain with limited external backlinks and blowing through LLM context windows (`1.5 MB` `llms.txt`).
